prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 常用化学试剂清单 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "名称" · longest unbreakable word 14px · one-line width 107px
  col 2: header "分子式" · longest unbreakable word 120px · one-line width 120px
  col 3: header "CAS 号" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 69px
  col 4: header "纯度" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 118px
  col 5: header "储存条件（长）" · longest unbreakable word 40px · one-line width 993px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 604px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 603px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"列出常用化学试剂的身份、纯度和储存要求，供查找、核对及安全存放时使用。","reading":"读者可先按名称查找，再沿同一行核对分子式、CAS 号、纯度和储存条件；储存说明较长，通常需要多行，形成的行高可容纳其他单元格适度换行。","groups":["名称、分子式和 CAS 号共同标识试剂，其中分子式和 CAS 号用于精确核对。","纯度与储存条件分别说明试剂规格和保管要求，均应与对应试剂保持清晰的行关联。"],"keep_intact":["分子式和 CAS 号应分别保持完整，避免在标识符内部断行。","纯度数值、百分号及范围宜保持在一起；试剂名称也应尽量完整。"],"may_wrap":["储存条件是自然语言说明，可在词语或标点处换行。","纯度等级与百分数之间可换行；较长的中文试剂名称必要时可换行。","储存条件表头可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [95, 141, 90, 90, 187] · table 604×1072px · row heights [33, 134, 154, 154, 154, 134, 154, 154] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [128, 141, 90, 90, 154] · table 604×1233px · row heights [33, 174, 174, 174, 174, 154, 174, 174] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [108, 141, 90, 90, 174] · table 604×1092px · row heights [33, 154, 154, 154, 154, 134, 154, 154] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"分子式和 CAS 号完整，纯度等级与数值分行后仍易于核对；储存说明在三个方案中最宽，行高较紧凑。","problems":"长试剂名称断成两行；储存说明仍较密，部分词组跨行，左侧短内容下方留有大片空白。","cause":"名称列为 95px，不足以容纳最长名称；储存列为 187px，虽是三个方案中最宽，仍需承载很长的说明。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"名称、分子式和 CAS 号均完整显示，身份信息便于横向核对。","problems":"储存说明过于狭窄，断行频繁，部分温度值与单位分离；各行很高，左侧空白较多，跨行查找费力。","cause":"名称列增至 128px，满足最长名称的一行宽度，但储存列因此缩至 154px。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"分子式和 CAS 号完整；储存列比 r2B 宽，说明的行数和表格高度有所下降。","problems":"最长名称仍断行，名称列增加的宽度未能使其完整显示；储存说明仍较窄，且部分词组跨行。","cause":"名称列为 108px，低于最长名称所需的约 128px；储存列为 174px，比 r2A 少 13px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"storage-first","widths":[88,141,90,83,201],"change":"以 r2A 为基础，略缩名称列和纯度列，把空间给储存说明；保留分子式、CAS 号及纯度范围的完整性，接受最长名称换行。"},{"name":"names-intact","widths":[128,141,90,69,175],"change":"名称列保留完整显示最长名称所需的宽度，缩窄纯度列以恢复储存列宽度；纯度等级和数值分行，同时保留最长范围所需的文本宽度。"},{"name":"balanced-storage","widths":[95,141,90,69,208],"change":"保留 r2A 的名称宽度，将纯度列缩至仍可容纳最长纯度数值的宽度，进一步扩宽储存说明，检验说明行数和断行是否改善。"}]}
